fragility_note: The H0 still ignores BrokerError.category and classifies by message keywords (timeout / budget / exhaust / quota / limit / cancel / denied / refus / ...). Its correct behaviour therefore depends on the exact public message texts; e.g. a future non-exhaustion message containing 'limit', 'quota' or 'exhaust' would reintroduce V3-1. Root's new platform test forbids only 'budget'; freezing the message texts per interface version (or extending the test to the other keywords) keeps this recheck valid. Any wording change invalidates this recheck.
